usageNotes: Creates and starts a Ceph Metadata Server (MDS) daemon on the specified node, which is required for CephFS to function. Requires `Sys.Modify` on the root path and the target node must be online with Ceph already initialized. Returns a task UPID — poll the task status to confirm the daemon reaches `active` or `standby` state before relying on CephFS.

examples.summary: Create an MDS on pve1 with hot-standby enabled for faster failover

tips: Ceph recommends at least one active MDS plus one standby; deploy MDS daemons on at least two nodes for HA.
Setting hotstandby=true causes the standby MDS to tail the active MDS journal, enabling sub-second failover at the cost of extra RAM and CPU on the standby node.
The `name` path param defaults to the node name if omitted — using the node name keeps daemon naming predictable and consistent with Proxmox conventions.
After creation, verify daemon state with GET /nodes/{node}/ceph/mds or check the Ceph dashboard; the daemon must reach `active` or `standby` before CephFS mounts will work.
